rv.q: At North Coast Repertory Theatre, Tom Frey’s carefully calibrated production is funny, fast, and unexpectedly moving, with David Corlew delivering a remarkable performance as Oscar Levant.

Sean Hayes gives a consummate, larger-than-life performance as Oscar, channelling a profoundly unsettled, manic energy, constantly twitching, rocking in his chair and performing obsessive-compulsive ticks
Hayes’s brilliance elevates it into a must-see
Hayes unleashes a virtuoso piano performance in which all his torment spills out over the keys, his passionate playing sapping him and sustaining him all at once
Corlew’s performance will create quite a buzz, ensuring a successful run to kick off NCR’s 45th season.

Quite a lot, as it turns out, and Good Night, Oscar makes wonderful use of it all. At North Coast Repertory Theatre, Tom Frey ’s carefully calibrated production is funny, fast, and unexpectedly moving, with David Corlew delivering a remarkable performance as Oscar Levant .
Doug Wright's swift-paced and entertaining 2022 play "Good Night, Oscar" has brought him back in a touching, funny and thoughtful way.
The West Coast premiere of the comedy-drama is a rich examination of an equally tortured and gifted entertainer.
